Review: Lowest common ancestor in a binary tree

Type: question · Current state: pending_review

View the public page (if published)

Content

Given the root of a binary tree and two nodes, find the lowest common ancestor. Assume each node has a parent pointer. Discuss the time and space tradeoffs.

Answer guidance

Two common approaches: storing visited ancestors in a set, or aligning depths and walking up. Mention which is faster and why.
